errors.text_span: Eine blaue, durchgezogene Linie stellt den realen Mindestlohn dar.
errors.evidence: The line representing the real minimum wage is purple, not blue.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei einem Wert von rund 101 im Januar 2015
errors.evidence: The purple line for the real minimum wage starts exactly at 100, as stated in the legend: (Januar 2015 = 100).

errors.text_span: steigt bis zu etwa 105 im Juli 2016 an
errors.evidence: In July 2016, the value of the purple line is approximately 99, not 105.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis zum Juli 2018 wieder auf etwa 104 steigt
errors.evidence: In July 2018, the value of the purple line is approximately 99, not 104.
In January 2020, the value of the purple line is approximately 100, not 97.
The description omits any mention of the light blue line, which represents "Arbeitsproduktivität auf Stundenbasis (Index, 1. Quartal 2015 = 100)" and covers the period from 2015 to 2023.

errors.text_span: Eine dunkelblaue, durchgezogene Linie stellt die Produktivität pro Stunde dar. Sie beginnt im Januar 2015 mit einem Wert von rund 100.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly merges two distinct lines for productivity (one light blue, one dark blue) into a single entity. The dark blue line starts in late 2022, not in January 2015.

errors.text_span: und weist im Juli 2022 einen Tiefstand von 94 auf
errors.evidence: This data point is incorrectly attributed to the productivity line. The low point around 95-96 in July 2022 belongs to the purple line (real minimum wage). The productivity line is at a value of approximately 107 at this time.
